subject: Mixed (Real Weightage)
description: 100 questions following the real PGP-CET 2025 subject weightage. Mix: 0 easy / 6 medium / 94 hard. Every question cites its source.

questions.question: Tom Smith arthritis is due to:
questions.explanation: Tom Smith arthritis is septic arthritis of the hip in infancy with destruction of the femoral head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: Which of the following statements about pulmonary changes in pregnancy is FALSE?

options.A: The diaphragm rises by about 4 cm
options.B: The AP and transverse chest diameters each increase by about 2 cm
options.D: The chest circumference increases by 5-7 cm

questions.explanation: The subcostal angle widens in pregnancy as the lower ribs flare.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: OBGY

questions.question: Which of the following EMG picture is true in the diagnosis of myopathy?

options.A: Spontaneous activity and partial interference pattern of decreased amplitude and duration on volition
options.B: Spontaneous activity with short duration low amplitude polyphasic potential on volition
options.C: High frequency respective discharge with alternate increased and decreased in amplitude

questions.explanation: Myopathy shows short-duration, low-amplitude polyphasic potentials.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation O'Sullivan/4th Ed./Pg. 223
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: The body's center of gravity in an adult normally has up and down movements of:
questions.explanation: In walking the centre of gravity rises and falls about 2.5 inches (5 cm).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 449
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: 'No man's land' of the hand refers to the area between the:

options.B: Wrist crease and the distal palmar crease
options.D: Distal palmar crease and the insertion of flexor digitorum superficialis (MCP to PIP region)

questions.explanation: Zone II flexor tendon injuries have a poor outcome because both flexor tendons share a tight sheath.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: If the prosthesis is too long, which gait deviations may be seen?
questions.explanation: An over-long prosthesis must be cleared by circumduction, abduction or vaulting on the sound side.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Spasticity first appears at Brunnstrom stage:
questions.explanation: Stage 1 is flaccidity; spasticity and minimal synergies appear at stage 2.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: According to the Wagner classification, a deep ulcer with osteomyelitis or abscess is grade:
questions.explanation: Wagner 3: deep ulcer with abscess or osteomyelitis.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Pathology & Microbiology

questions.question: Acute infantile spinal muscular atrophy is also called:
questions.explanation: SMA type 1 presents before 6 months and is the severe infantile form.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: The following are pressure-sensitive areas in a PTB (below-knee) prosthesis EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: The patellar tendon is a pressure-tolerant area used to bear weight.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of McKenzie's postural syndrome?

options.A: No pain with activity or movement

questions.explanation: Postural syndrome involves intermittent pain from sustained positions with no deformity and no radicular signs.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Which of the following statements is FALSE for a positively skewed distribution?

options.B: The tail points to the right
options.C: The median lies to the right of the mode
options.D: The mean is to the right of the mode

questions.explanation: In positive skew the longer tail is on the right.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: In phase 2 of scapulohumeral rhythm the clavicular motion is about:
questions.explanation: Clavicle elevation of about 15 degrees occurs at the SC joint in phase 2.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: In order to localise the traction force at the mid cervical spine, the neck should be positioned in:
questions.explanation: Neutral to slight flexion affects upper segments, 10-20 degrees mid-cervical and 25-35 degrees lower cervical.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Goose neck deformity of the left ventricular outflow tract on angiography is a feature of:

options.B: Atrial septal defect (ostium primum / AV canal defect)

questions.explanation: The goose-neck sign is characteristic of endocardial cushion (primum ASD) defects.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: In which of the following conditions numerous white spots are seen on the X-rays of many bones.
questions.explanation: Osteopoikilosis shows numerous small sclerotic (white) spots in many bones on X-ray.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: The loose-packed position of the proximal radioulnar joint is:

options.A: 70 degrees of flexion with 35 degrees of supination

questions.explanation: The proximal radioulnar joint is open-packed at 70 degrees of elbow flexion and 35 degrees of supination.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Approx. 40% at patients with congenital pseudoarthrosis of tibia present with lesion typical of:
questions.explanation: About 40 percent of congenital pseudarthrosis of the tibia is associated with neurofibromatosis (von Recklinghausen disease).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: The D2 extension pattern of the upper limb consists of:
questions.explanation: D2 extension is the reverse of D2 flexion.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Exercise Therapy

questions.question: The PEP used in low pressure positive expiratory pressure therapy is about:
questions.explanation: Low-pressure PEP uses 10-20 cm H2O; high-pressure PEP uses forced expiration against a mask.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: Which of the following drugs does NOT have a positive inotropic effect?
questions.explanation: Furosemide is a diuretic; digoxin and dobutamine increase contractility.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Pharmacology

questions.question: On manual muscle testing, full range against gravity with moderate resistance is graded:
questions.explanation: Grade 4 = moderate resistance.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: There is an ______ relation between absorption of ultrasound and its penetration.
questions.explanation: The more energy a tissue absorbs, the less deeply the beam penetrates.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Loading response is the amount of time taken:

options.A: Between initial contact of one leg and terminal swing of the other leg
options.B: Between initial contact of one leg and initial swing (toe off) of the other leg
options.C: Between mid stance and heel off
options.D: Between initial contact of one leg and initial swing of the same leg

questions.explanation: Loading response is the first double-limb support period.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: A slump test performed in side-lying with the hip extended and knee flexed tensions the:
questions.explanation: The side-lying slump with hip extension and knee flexion is the femoral nerve (prone knee bend) variant.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A-alpha fibres carry:
questions.explanation: A-alpha are the largest fibres (Ia afferents and alpha motor neurons).
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: Swan neck deformity is characterised by:

options.A: MCP and DIP flexion with PIP hyperextension
options.B: PIP and DIP extension with MCP flexion
options.D: MCP and DIP extension with PIP flexion

questions.explanation: Intrinsic tightness and dorsal subluxation of the lateral bands give PIP hyperextension and DIP flexion.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a sign or symptom of hypoglycaemia?
questions.explanation: Acetone breath is a feature of ketoacidosis from hyperglycaemia.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: The total pelvic rotation that occurs during a gait cycle is about:
questions.explanation: The pelvis rotates about 4 degrees to each side, a total of 8 degrees.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: Panacinar emphysema in a young non-smoker is associated with ______ levels of alpha-1 antitrypsin.
questions.explanation: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency allows unchecked elastase action and early emphysema.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The ligament of the wrist that limits excessive ulnar deviation is the:
questions.explanation: The radial collateral ligament becomes taut in ulnar deviation.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Anatomy

questions.question: In the upright position, the ventilation-perfusion ratio is lowest (shunt-like) at the ______ of the lung.
questions.explanation: Perfusion exceeds ventilation at the base, giving a low V/Q.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: The right coronary artery supplies all of the following EXCEPT the:

options.D: Anterior portion of the interventricular septum

questions.explanation: The anterior interventricular septum is supplied by the left anterior descending artery.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Anatomy

questions.question: A single-bar AFO with a medial T-strap is used to correct:
questions.explanation: A medial T-strap pulls the ankle laterally, correcting valgus deformity.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Exercise Therapy

questions.question: Which of the following are signs and symptoms of hyperglycaemia?

options.C: Acetone breath and dry mouth with glucose above 300 mg/dL

questions.explanation: Marked hyperglycaemia causes polyuria, thirst and ketotic breath.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: In the thoracic or lumbar spine in neutral or extension, coupled side flexion and rotation occur in the:
questions.explanation: Fryette type I: in neutral, side flexion and rotation occur in opposite directions.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: A positive diagnostic test can rule IN a diagnosis, provided the test has:
questions.explanation: SpPIn: a highly specific test, when positive, rules the condition in.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: Which of the following is an ABSOLUTE contraindication to exercise in pregnant women?
questions.explanation: Significant heart disease, pre-eclampsia, persistent bleeding and ruptured membranes contraindicate exercise.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: OBGY

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding effects of direct current is false?

options.A: It causes excitation of peripheral nerves
options.B: It cause alteration in protein synthesis
options.D: It causes change in thermal and chemical balance of tissues

questions.explanation: Direct current does not cause smooth muscle contraction in the manner described; it affects excitability, chemistry and temperature.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Electrotherapy Explained/Low and Reed/3rd Ed./Pg. 41
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: In which of the following injuries around the hip is there true lengthening of the concerned lower limb?
questions.explanation: Anterior hip dislocation gives true lengthening of the limb, with abduction and external rotation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: A physical therapist observes excessive knee flexion from heel strike to midstance while observing patient with a transtibial amputation during gait training. A possible cause for this deviation is:

options.A: The foot is set in neutral
options.B: The socket is set posterior in relation to the foot
options.D: The socket is aligned in excessive flexion

questions.explanation: Excessive knee flexion at heel strike to mid-stance in a transtibial prosthesis is due to excessive socket flexion, a dorsiflexed foot or a stiff heel.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Which of the following statements is FALSE for the effect of sympathetic stimulation on the heart?

options.A: It results in vasoconstriction of cardiac (coronary) vessels
options.D: It increases rate and force of contraction

questions.explanation: Sympathetic stimulation increases rate, force and metabolism, and the coronary vessels dilate.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE regarding silver sulfadiazine?

options.B: It does not penetrate eschar well
options.C: It cannot be used under a dressing

questions.explanation: Silver sulfadiazine is broad spectrum (including Candida) but penetrates eschar poorly, unlike mafenide acetate.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Pharmacology

questions.question: A therapist positions a patient in prone with two pillows under the hips in preparation for bronchial drainage. If the therapist's goal is to perform bronchial drainage to the superior segments of the lower lobes, which area should the therapist's force be directed.

options.A: Between the clavicle and nipple on each side
options.B: Over the area between the clavicle and top of the scapula on each side of the spine
options.C: Over the lower ribs on each side
options.D: Over the middle of the back at the tip of the scapula on each side of the spine

questions.explanation: Superior segments of the lower lobes are percussed over the mid-back at the scapular tip.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: Which therapeutic modality would be a relative contraindication in a pediatric patient with juvenile rheumatoid arthritis?
questions.explanation: Ultrasound over growing epiphyses is a relative contraindication.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Basal metabolic rate is increased by:
questions.explanation: Normal BMR is about 1 kcal per kg per hour.
questions.sourceBook: U. Satyanarayana, Biochemistry; Harper's Illustrated Biochemistry (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Biochemistry

questions.question: A POMA score of less than 19 indicates:
questions.explanation: 19-24 is moderate fall risk; below 19 is high.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: On EMG, the interference pattern (recruitment) in a myogenic lesion is:
questions.explanation: In myopathy, many small units are recruited early giving a full pattern of low amplitude.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: In Pauwels' classification, a fracture line angle of 30-50 degrees to the horizontal is:
questions.explanation: Type 2 lies between 30 and 50 degrees.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: When kidney damage is associated with a mild reduction in GFR (60-89), CKD is staged as:
questions.explanation: Stage 2: GFR 60-89.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: The open basket weave taping technique is commonly used as a form of treatment for an acute ankle sprain. Which of the following does not accurately describe the benefits of the open basketweave taping technique?

options.A: Allows freedom of movement in dorsiflexion
options.B: Allows freedom of movement in plantar flexion

questions.explanation: The open basket-weave technique allows room for oedema, so that is a benefit; option C is described as not a benefit in the source key.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: The paleocerebellum (spinocerebellum) is responsible for:

options.C: Synergistic control of muscle tone and posture

questions.explanation: The anterior lobe/vermis regulates muscle tone, gait and posture.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: With ageing, all of the following ECG changes are seen EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Conduction slows with age; the QRS widens rather than narrows.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: In a neurogenic lesion, the MUAP amplitude is:
questions.explanation: Reinnervation by surviving axons enlarges motor units, giving high-amplitude, long-duration MUAPs.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: In intermittent pneumatic compression the inflation pressure should be:

options.C: Between 30 and 80 mm Hg but not above the patient's diastolic pressure

questions.explanation: Pressures below arteriolar capillary pressure are ineffective and above diastolic pressure risk ischaemia.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: A single-bar AFO with a lateral T-strap is used for:
questions.explanation: A lateral T-strap pulls the ankle medially and corrects a varus foot.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Exercise Therapy

questions.question: Rearfoot varus refers to a rigid:
questions.explanation: Rearfoot varus is a structural inversion of the calcaneus relative to the tibia.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Pronator syndrome is median nerve entrapment at the site between:

options.C: The carpal ligament and the wrist bones
options.D: The two heads of pronator teres (and FDS arch)

questions.explanation: In pronator syndrome the median nerve is compressed in the proximal forearm.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: In the preparation phase of periodised training the volume of exercise is ______ and the frequency is ______.
questions.explanation: Preparation: high volume, more frequent sessions, low intensity.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of McKenzie's derangement syndrome?

options.A: No pain with activity or movement

questions.explanation: In derangement, pain is related to movement and posture, with directional preference and possible loss of movement.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Echolalia is:

options.D: Meaningless repetition of another person's words

questions.explanation: Seen in catatonia and autism.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Psychiatry

questions.question: For an adult wheelchair, the height from the push handle to the floor is about:
questions.explanation: Push handles are about 36 inches above the floor.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Exercise Therapy

questions.question: The talar tilt test, in which excessive adduction (inversion) of the talus is found, indicates injury of the:
questions.explanation: Inversion talar tilt tests the calcaneofibular ligament; eversion tilt tests the deltoid.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A therapist examines the elbow of a patient rehabilitating from a radial head fracture. Which of the following most accurately describes the close packed position of the radiohumeral joint?
questions.explanation: The radiohumeral joint is close-packed at 90 degrees flexion and 5 degrees supination.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopedic Physical Assessment/Magee/5th Ed./Pg. 362
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: The standard functional reach for adults aged 20-40 years is about:
questions.explanation: Duncan's norms: 20-40 years about 14.5-17 inches.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: The D2 flexion pattern of the upper limb consists of:
questions.explanation: D2 flexion moves the arm like drawing a sword: flexion, abduction and external rotation.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Exercise Therapy

questions.question: A negative diagnostic test can rule OUT a diagnosis, provided the test has:
questions.explanation: SnNOut: a highly sensitive test, when negative, rules the condition out.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: Which transfer technique is used when a patient has a complete spinal cord injury at C5-C6 level?
questions.explanation: C5-C6 patients usually need a sliding board with assistance.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: The filter used for filtering short UVR is:
questions.explanation: Cellophane or blue uviol glass filters short-wave UV.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Compared with the Flutter device, the Acapella device is:

options.A: Not dependent on gravity (can be used in any position)

questions.explanation: Acapella uses a counterweighted lever so it works in any position.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: Hip abductor, knee flexor and dorsiflexor weakness is expected when the level of spina bifida involvement is:
questions.explanation: L4-L5 supply gluteus medius, hamstrings and tibialis anterior.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: A patient with a transfemoral amputation is referred to physical therapy for gait training. During the initial examination the therapist identifies lateral trunk bending towards the affected side during the stance phase of gait. A possible cause of this deviation is:

options.C: The socket diameter is too small
options.D: There is an increased amount of edema in the residual limb

questions.explanation: Lateral trunk bending toward the prosthetic side in stance can be caused by a prosthesis that is too short, an abducted socket, weak abductors or pain.

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: The pressure produced by a short-stretch bandage is ______ at rest and ______ when the muscle expands.
questions.explanation: Short-stretch bandages give low resting pressure and high working pressure (venous pump support).
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: On chest X-ray the silhouette sign presents as:

options.A: The two separate structures adjacent to each other are not identified because of lack of difference in bone densities
options.B: Paralysis of diaphragm over shadows the lung
options.C: Enlargement of cardiac field in the transverse direction
options.D: A sharp contrast between two adjacent

questions.explanation: The silhouette sign is loss of the border between adjacent structures of similar density.

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: In Adson's test the radial pulse is monitored while the patient rotates the head toward the involved side and extends it with deep inspiration; loss of pulse suggests:
questions.explanation: Adson's test assesses compression of the subclavian artery and brachial plexus between the scalenes.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: According to the symmetrical tonic neck reflex (STNR), when the head is flexed the arms ______ and the legs ______.
questions.explanation: Neck flexion increases arm flexion and leg extension.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: Which mineral toxicity can lead to defects in the nails of the fingers and toes?
questions.explanation: Selenosis causes brittle nails and hair loss.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: In the BODE index, obstruction, dyspnoea and exercise capacity are measured respectively by:

options.A: FEV1 predicted, MMRC dyspnoea scale and 6-minute walk test
options.B: FVC, MMRC dyspnoea scale and 3-minute walk test
options.C: PEFR, Borg scale and stair climb
options.D: FEV1 predicted, MMRC dyspnoea scale and 12-minute walk test

questions.explanation: The BODE uses FEV1 percent predicted, the modified MRC scale and the 6-minute walk distance.

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: The correct sequence of autogenic drainage is:

options.A: Collect phase, evacuation phase, unstick phase
options.C: Evacuation phase, unstick phase, collect phase
options.D: Unstick phase, collect phase, evacuation phase

questions.explanation: Breathing at low lung volumes loosens mucus, mid volumes collect it and high volumes evacuate it.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: A therapist conducts a study which measures knee flexion range of motion two weeks following arthroscopic surgery. Assuring a normal distribution what percentage of patients participating in the study would you expect to achieve a goniometeric measurement value greater than one standard deviation below the mean:
